title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees

scenes.text: Sharks have swum the oceans for more than four hundred million years. The first true trees only showed up around three hundred and eighty-five million years ago.
So sharks were already hunting while the tallest plant on land was a moss a few centimetres high.
They're older than the dinosaurs too. The dinosaurs lasted about a hundred and sixty-five million years. Sharks have done two and a half times that.
They lasted because the design just works. A fast body, a light skeleton of cartilage, and teeth that keep replacing themselves.
Every shark alive is the result of four hundred million years of testing. Which animal do you think is older than it looks?

description:
Sharks are older than trees.
Sharks have existed for more than 400 million years, while the first true trees appeared around 385 million years ago. They also outdate the dinosaurs, whose entire reign lasted about 165 million years.
Their design simply works: a streamlined body, a light cartilage skeleton and endlessly replaced teeth.
Which animal do you think is older than it looks?
